name: Password recovery completion sets new password and redirects to dashboard
description: End-to-end regression coverage for PR #49 (fix(auth): unblock password recovery completion). Uses the DEDICATED recovery fixture user e2e.recovery@lanonasis.com - never the suite login credential - so password changes cannot poison the authenticated suite. NOTE: step 6 requires a recovery link fixture (test email inbox or Supabase admin generate_link).

planSteps.description: Click the 'Forgot password?' link in the sign-in card
Fill e2e.recovery@lanonasis.com into the email field (dedicated recovery fixture user, NOT the suite login credential)
Verify the page shows a confirmation message like 'Check your email' or 'We sent a reset link'
Obtain the recovery link for e2e.recovery@lanonasis.com from the test email inbox or Supabase admin generate_link fixture and navigate to it
Verify the page shows the heading 'Set a new password' and the password form is visible
Fill a new password into the 'New password' field
Fill the same password into the 'Confirm new password' field
Verify the URL changes to /dashboard or a success toast says 'Password updated'
Verify the dashboard overview page is visible
